title: A broad supplier-name surface can remain financially concentrated
source_unit: USAspending subaward records linked to one DoD JASSM/LRASM parent contract
geography: United States parent award; subordinate recipient locations are not supplied in this extract

observations.period: 2024-10-23 through 2025-02-28; supplier concentration in returned subaward records

denominator.unit: returned USAspending subaward records linked to one parent award

reported_subaward_amount.unit: nominal US dollars in returned records

recipient_amount_hhi.unit: sum of squared recipient amount shares in returned extract

repeat_recipient_count.unit: recipient names appearing in more than one returned record

observations.method: Official USAspending committed subaward response for one JASSM/LRASM parent award; recipient amounts are summed by reported recipient name; concentration is computed on returned-record reported amounts.
observations.uncertainty: Single parent award and one returned page; recipient names are not reconciled to legal-entity or parent ownership; subaward visibility, amendments, subordinate tiers, locations, and production are incomplete. HHI and top-recipient shares describe this extract, not a defense-industrial market.
observations.subgroup: Reported recipient names ranked by summed amount
observations.counterinterpretation: Supplier-name breadth is not replaceability, competition, production capacity, delivery, or geopolitical leverage. Reported component descriptions are not a bill of materials, output count, or proof of integration.

description_term_counts.unit: records containing coded text terms; overlapping terms allowed

observations.method: Case-insensitive presence coding of selected terms in returned free-text subaward descriptions; terms are overlapping examples, not a component taxonomy.
observations.uncertainty: Single parent award and one returned page; recipient names are not reconciled to legal-entity or parent ownership; subaward visibility, amendments, subordinate tiers, locations, and production are incomplete. HHI and top-recipient shares describe this extract, not a defense-industrial market.
observations.counterinterpretation: Supplier-name breadth is not replaceability, competition, production capacity, delivery, or geopolitical leverage. Reported component descriptions are not a bill of materials, output count, or proof of integration.

related_sources.claim: USAspending documents the subaward endpoint and returned award fields.

boundary: Supplier-name breadth is not replaceability, competition, production capacity, delivery, or geopolitical leverage. Reported component descriptions are not a bill of materials, output count, or proof of integration.
